rv.q: The duo’s moments of discord gather into a profound connection.
Even if you've caught the play before, this impeccable production is a must-see.
Strong is wondrous, radiating hopefulness even as the prospects for romance dim.
Audible and TOGETHER should be commended for mounting this first-class revival of a play that shouldn’t be as obscure as it is.
What Happened Was... is made stronger by the seriousness with which the cast approaches the material.

Strong is astonishing, her face radiating a mix of caution and eagerness that comes to full fruition when he persuades her to read her latest work of fiction, a dark “children’s story” that’s shockingly violent, sexual, and twisted.

cn.t: Critics praise this intimate revival of Tom Noonan's 1992 first-date play for its excellent performances by Stoll and Strong, capturing the awkwardness and emotional depth of two colleagues' unsettling evening together.

vr.q: They are what makes this a beautiful production about how we aren't just extras in each other's stories — we're all layered and lonely in our own ways.
